Trace, implement and test: Decode and find the character in the sting available

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Decode and find the character in the sting available
s = list(input().strip())
n = int(input())
print(s)
sums = 0
flag = 0
for i in range(1, len(s), 2):
    x = int(s[i])
    sums += x
    if sums >= n:
        flag = 1
        break
if flag == 1:
    print(s[i-1])
else:
    print('Not found')
